messages:
Maria: quick check — starting a per-account rollout for a priority-routing feature for a subset of enterprise customers. plan = contract-gated allowlist + small canary + manual kill-switch. need owners on config PR, SRE guardrails, and product signoff on contract ids and EU-first rollout.

Devon: what exact flag key do we want? and is 5% of seats our canary metric or 5% of accounts? also do we need per-tenant rate limits?

Maria: flag key = `tenant:feature/priority-routing:v2`. canary = 5% of accounts (not seats) chosen by contract segment. allowlist will be contract_ids array in rollout-config. yes, per-tenant rate limit = 500 rps initial guardrail.

Aj: note re: runtime behavior — fallback model mapping should be explicit. if priority-routing path errors, route to `mosaic-instruct-1` and increment a telemetry counter `priority_routing.fallbacks`. also recommend warming KV-cache for VIP tenants on rollout start.

Lina: SRE checklist: circuit-breaker (>10% 5xx or >15% latency p95 increase for 5m) -> auto-disable for that tenant, and global kill-switch. need logs to include `tenant.contract_id=<id>` and forward to observability. can we add an autoscale override for this pool to avoid noisy neighbor impact?

Sam-Sales: customer ask: limit to ACME corp contract ids 2003 and 2007 for phase 1. they want EU only initially. i'll notify account execs once rollout window is set.

Maria: EU-first: region filter `eu-west1`. Devon — can you open the PR in `rollout-config` with the allowlist + slice and add a manual feature toggle key `feature.kill.priority-routing`? put the rollout window and region constraints in the config.

Devon: on it. drafting PR now. snippet I'll include:

```json
{
  "flag_key": "tenant:feature/priority-routing:v2",
  "allowlist_contract_ids": [2003, 2007],
  "canary": {"type": "percent_of_accounts", "value": 5},
  "region_filter": ["eu-west1"],
  "kill_switch_key": "feature.kill.priority-routing",
  "rbac_reviewed_by": "Maria"
}
```

Devon: PR draft link: https://github.com/redwood/rollout-config/pull/492 (will update with infra deps)

deploy-bot: rollout-svc: scheduled canary start 2024-05-10T14:00:00Z for flag `tenant:feature/priority-routing:v2`. initiated by @Maria. runbook: https://redwood.company/runbooks/priority-routing-rollout

Aj: I'll add model-fallback unit tests and a quick sim load to validate KV warmups. tagging @Lina for SRE test matrix.

Lina: ACK. i'll add guardrail monitors and an automatic tenant-disable playbook. if thresholds hit, the runbook will trigger `feature.kill.priority-routing` and notify #incidents.

Maria: perfect. next steps: Devon PR + SRE monitors ready by EOD tomorrow, Sam to confirm customer communications window. thanks all :thumbsup:
